title: Assertion: Data Stable While Stalled
constraints: Rule: if `valid && !ready` at a rising edge, then at the next edge `data` must be unchanged.
Report a violation with a failing assertion (or `$error`). Legal traces must produce no error. `rst` is active high; ignore everything while it is asserted.
hints: `$stable(data)` compares data with its value at the previous sample.

examples.title: held
examples.input: valid=1, ready=0 for 3 cycles, data constant

examples.check: legal: data may change after a transfer
examples.title: after transfer
